messages:
Mia: quick share — ran a 3-way sweep (L4 / T4 / A10G) for embeddings + small-chat across us-west1, eu-west1, ap-southeast1 this morning. put the high-level numbers below, plus a couple of surprising kernel/quant interactions.

Ravi: nice — do you have p95 and throughput at different batch sizes?

Mia: yup. kept the configs consistent:
- embeddings: bf16 baseline, 8-bit qint8, 4-bit q4x with act-order; batch sizes 64/256/1024 (requests/sec measured)
- small-chat: seq len 128, steady-state streaming, batching disabled for latency SLO, quant 8-bit and 4-bit tested

Mia: embeddings (us-west1, batch=256) p95 / throughput / est cost per 1M embed ops:
```
L4  (fp16)   p95=18ms   throughput=2.9k rps   cost≈$24
T4  (fp16)   p95=27ms   throughput=2.1k rps   cost≈$19
A10G(fp16)   p95=11ms   throughput=4.6k rps   cost≈$38
L4  (q8)     p95=20ms   throughput=2.7k rps   cost≈$18
T4  (q8)     p95=29ms   throughput=2.0k rps   cost≈$14
A10G(q8)     p95=12ms   throughput=4.3k rps   cost≈$34
L4  (q4x)    p95=32ms   throughput=1.9k rps   cost≈$13  (note: higher p95 on L4 q4x)
T4  (q4x)    p95=38ms   throughput=1.6k rps   cost≈$11
A10G(q4x)    p95=18ms   throughput=3.2k rps   cost≈$24
```

Mia: small-chat (eu-west1, streaming, no batch) p95 / tokens/sec:
```
L4  fp16  p95=85ms  tokens/s≈280  cost≈$0.32 per 1k tokens
T4  fp16  p95=120ms tokens/s≈200  cost≈$0.24 per 1k tokens
A10G fp16 p95=48ms  tokens/s≈520  cost≈$0.58 per 1k tokens
L4  q8   p95=92ms  tokens/s≈260
T4  q8   p95=130ms tokens/s≈190
A10G q8  p95=55ms  tokens/s≈480
L4  q4x  p95=210ms tokens/s≈110  (quality regressions)
T4  q4x  p95=260ms tokens/s≈90
A10G q4x p95=120ms tokens/s≈320
```

Elena: notable — the 4-bit numbers look worse on L4/T4 than i expected. is that kernel immaturity or KV-cache thrash?

Mia: mostly kernel/memory layout. we saw a ~25% extra memcpy on the T4 driver stack causing KV cache pressure at seq len 128. on A10G the optimized fused-kernel handles q4x better.

Jun: FYI ap-southeast1 runs a slightly older CUDA/driver on our infra (nv 12.1 vs 12.3 in us/eu). i bet that's why apac saw an extra 15–20% latency for the q4x runs. recommend pinning kernel fallback for apac until we push the new driver image.

Ivy: capacity recs from the sweep: for embeddings at 99th pct load target (prod), plan:
- T4 eu-west1: reserve 12% headroom vs measured throughput (so commit ~2.4k rps per node instead of 2.1k)
- L4 us-west1: prefer 1.5x replication for tail when using q4x (p95 spikes)
- A10G: can reduce reserved headroom to ~5% for embeddings; great for throughput-heavy customers

Ravi: did you run any quality evals for small-chat with q4x? numbers?

Mia: quick eval on our prompt set (1000 examples): sensicality score (higher better) and hallucination flag rate:
- fp16 baseline: sensicality=0.92, hallucination=0.05
- q8: sensicality=0.91, hallucination=0.06
- q4x: sensicality=0.87, hallucination=0.09 (L4/T4), q4x on A10G: 0.89/0.07
So q4x introduces a measurable reg on L4/T4 — A10G is more forgiving.

Elena: thanks — that matches what i saw in evals. propose we gate q4x on non-critical SLAs for L4/T4 and recommend A10G for aggressive quant deployments.

Mia: agreement + action items:
1) Jun to schedule driver image push to ap-southeast1 (pin date by EOD) @Jun :calendar:
2) Ops: add a Canary policy that disables q4x on T4/L4 for small-chat routes unless `force_quant=true` in route config @Ivy
3) Eng-ml: open ticket to upstream fused-kernel fixes for L4 q4x memcpy path (assign to @Ravi)

Ravi: opened PERF-2314 and added the kernel traces + perfbot snapshot.

perf-bot: snapshot uploaded — https://internal/perf/snapshots/1718504321 (summary attached) :white_check_mark:

Ivy: will update capacity planning doc and set the Dedicated commit suggestions accordingly.

Mia: thanks all. happy to drop raw logs/bench scripts if anyone wants to reproduce.
